method: mechanical reconstruction from frozen Wave-2/Wave-3 predictions, combined measurement results, transition matrix, regression inventory, scorer source, and dev-corpus gold; zero LLM calls
primary_classification_counts_note: NOT_A_REGRESSION counts ROUT-030 (lateral flag, not in the 5-regression inventory); it is excluded from P0 total.

cases.mechanism: W2 emitted pseudo-route 'Hensikt' from leaked markdown heading token; W3 RC-07 heading-suppression removed it. W2 semantic lane could not adjudicate condition 'BUP routed for pure learning difficulties' against junk pseudo-route and returned M2:INSUFFICIENT_TO_DECIDE (UNRESOLVED). W3 honest no_route_asserted=true fires generic scorer rule R3 (PREMATURE_ABSENCE) before condition mapping; condition is free text and unmapped in CRITICAL_CONDITION_MAP.
cases.rationale: Different frozen observation mechanisms produce non-comparable states; W3 product output is materially more honest (junk route removed), not less safe. Generic R3 and semantic lane would both be UNRESOLVED-equivalent observations of the same underlying truth: no route asserted, no route exists yet.
cases.counterfactual_note: Diagnosis-only counterfactual: under the W2 owner, W3 output (routes=[], no_route_asserted=true, uncertainty no_route_found) would again be M2-insufficient on free-text condition, i.e. UNRESOLVED, not CRITICAL_ERROR.

cases.mechanism: W2 'Status' pseudo-route from heading token. W2 semantic lane found clear non-trigger support for 'direct family referral presented as standard'. W3 removes pseudo-route; no_route_asserted=true fires generic R3 before free-text condition can be evaluated.
cases.rationale: Owner change flips a semantic non-trigger judgment into a deterministic generic-rule firing; the product did not start presenting direct family referral as standard. The underlying proposition was never asserted in either wave.
cases.counterfactual_note: Diagnosis-only: W3 output under W2 owner would be M2-evaluable on condition text alone; the case answer contains family-vernet references in national-information blocks, so the semantic lane would most plausibly reproduce a non-trigger/insufficient decision, not CRITICAL_ERROR.

Owner DETERMINISTIC in both waves. W2 critical_error_if=None yielded NO_CRITICAL_ERROR only because the junk pseudo-route suppressed the generic R3 branch. W3 honest no_route_asserted=true triggers R3. See rout-069-analysis.md.

lateral_flag_case.rationale: FAIL -> FAIL state transition; verdicts differ (TRIGGERED vs CRITICAL_ERROR) but both map to state FAIL under frozen semantics. Apparent change is observation mechanism, not state severity. See rout-030-analysis.md.

wave4_rule.consequence: No isolated safety-preservation repair/gate is required to open Wave 4; do not reopen broad safety logic.
